description: Creates an attachment for the specified Checklist (Inspection).

id.description: Unique identifier for the attachment file.

url.description: URL to download the attachment file.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the attachment's thumbnail image.

filename.description: Name of the attached file. Deprecated; use `name` instead.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attached file.

viewable_document_id.description: Identifier of the viewable document generated for this file, when available.

attached_to_item_id.description: Identifier of the item the file is attached to.

attached_to_item_type.description: Type of item the file is attached to.
